basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Engineer | LLMs, RAG & Agentic Systems | Production GenAI on GCP & AWS
basics.summary: AI Engineer shipping production LLM, RAG, and multi-agent systems that move business metrics. Lead AI Engineer at LumApps building agentic workflows on GCP Vertex AI that 2x outbound conversions and forecast $1M in quarterly revenue. Prior: an in-house LLM translation pipeline at Beekeeper that eliminated $337K in annual vendor cost. On the side I co-founded SwissNRI, a RAG-grounded cross-border tax and compliance assistant for Swiss-Indian families, so I know first-hand what it takes to ship AI in a regulated, citation-critical domain. 13+ years of production engineering behind every AI system I put in front of customers.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Shipped production multi-agent LLM workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK over GCP Vertex AI, using ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation, with tools exposed over MCP servers. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, $4M forecast in approved opportunities per quarter.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j unifying Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts and product usage into one time-aware memory. Grounds RAG retrieval with a freshness layer that flags stale facts, cutting hallucinations across every agent.

Owned prompt engineering, eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), tool-selection tuning, and cost-per-request instrumentation, with on-call for global production systems. Reports directly to C-level on business outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline (OpenAI + GitHub Actions) shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated; product team iterates without external gatekeepers.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist with LangChain and CrewAI: personalized, high-touch guidance for every new signup. 100% of customers guided through setup without adding headcount.
Built GenAI demo generator for Sales. Auto-produces personalized content from Salesforce data using OpenAI and Langfuse for prompt evaluation. Improved demo speed and close rates.
Ran observability, MLOps and on-call for global production systems on AWS + Kubernetes (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io): logs, metrics, dashboards, alerting, and CI/CD across Jenkins and GitHub Actions.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ fintech and AI startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production; advised other portfolio companies on AI strategy and hiring.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight a live test of the model and control stack.
Engineered real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization algorithms. 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and control networks via genetic algorithms. Foundational ML work in optimization, search, and fitness landscapes.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students in genetic algorithms, neural controllers, and embodied AI.

Same playbook I bring to client engagements: technical discovery, multi-agent architecture, RAG grounding, eval pipelines, and observability from zero to production.

projects.name: SwissNRI - RAG-Grounded Cross-border Compliance
projects.description: AI-native cross-border tax and compliance platform for Swiss-Indian families. RAG-grounded assistant answers DTAA, FEMA and Swiss tax questions in plain language with citations back to the regulation; compliance-first agentic design flags risk before users file, with regulatory guardrails built before features. Zero-to-MVP in 3 months, 40% satisfaction uplift.

projects.name: PulseView - Explainable AI for Financial Markets
projects.description: Real-time market intelligence built for my own trading portfolio first, then opened to retail traders. AI agents generate AND justify trading signals from technical and news data, with explainability and evaluation built in: if the model can't explain the signal, it doesn't ship. Live users on real-time feeds today.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: AI Engineer at Swiss Re, Zurich. Design and develop AI solutions including LLMs, RAG, and generative AI. Prompt engineering, RAG architectures with vector databases and embeddings, fine-tuning conceptual knowhow, AI agents and orchestration frameworks. Python with strong SWE practices (VCS, testing, CI/CD, code reviews). MLOps tools (MLflow, W&B). SQL and data manipulation, PySpark plus. ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, HF Transformers) and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP). Nice to have: Palantir, insurance industry. Base: CHF 106K-158K. Data Science & AI department (Group Data Services), collaborating across Armonk NY, Zurich, Bangalore, Singapore, Beijing, Hong Kong.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit: Zurich hybrid, LLM/RAG/agents/prompt-eng/Python/GCP all match. SwissNRI (RAG-grounded compliance for financial cross-border domain) is the closest analogue to insurance/regulated fintech.
